extraction.Name: James McClosky
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded March 8, 1918 by R. R. Hazen
extraction.Buyer: James McClosky conveyed the land to William Assman for $5500.00
extraction.NOTES: Patent No. 612725 issued; receipt for the patent signed by the allottee February 6, 1918; conveyance dated March 8, 1918; the north half of section 23, township 98, range 78; Rosebud, S. Dak.
